body: MAINLINE-010 NFI-GEOM filed. All four levers are reported against P2-E and P2-A with margin, buckling SF, yield SF and crush stress. Shrinking the sphere or clustering is the strongest lever (buckling x9 at n=27) and is real geometry, not allowance spread, but every SF gain costs float margin and nothing reaches SF 1 while floating. Altitude trades lift for SF, and no partial-vacuum fraction helps at equal margin. Neither 007 nor 008 has filed, so lever 1 was not re-run; that is an NFI row. The material lever, 008, remains the one that must close the gap.
